```{r Data preparation}
#install.packages("gllvm")
library(gllvm)
library(dplyr)
#library(tidyverse)
set.seed(0)
data(microbialdata)
microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]
df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
    dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))
```


```{r running gllvm 1 l.v.}
# Create folder where fitted gllvms are stored
dir.create("gllvm_models", showWarnings = TRUE)
dir.create("gllvm_models/fitting", showWarnings = TRUE)

# Environmental covariated used in each fitted model
X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
Y = microbial[, 1:200]
# No. of l.v.
l.v. = 1
set.seed(0)

# Refit gllvm with 1 l.v. to each simulated dataset
time_i = system.time({
  gllvm_1 = gllvm(y = Y, X = X, num.lv = l.v., family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA")}) 

# Save fitted GLLVM from each simulation 
save(gllvm_1, file = file.path("gllvm_models/fitting", "gllvm_1.RDATA"))
load("gllvm_models/fitting/gllvm_1.RDATA")
# Obtain fitted Poisson conditional means from refitted model
pred_mu_gllvm1 = predict(gllvm_1, type = 'response', lv.pred = TRUE) #account for latent variable

mu = pred_mu_gllvm1

# Store summary quantities
time_gllvm1 = as.numeric(time_i[3])
loglik_new_gllvm1 = sum(dpois(as.matrix(Y), lambda = mu, log = TRUE)) # treats u as fixed parameters 
#  loglik_builtin_all_gllvm1[k] = gllvm_sim_1$logL #treats u as latent variables where integral needs to be marginalised over u

save(time_gllvm1, loglik_new_gllvm1, file = file.path("gllvm_models/fitting", "gllvm1_summary.RDATA"))
load(file.path("gllvm_models/fitting", "gllvm1_summary.RDATA"))
time_gllvm1
loglik_new_gllvm1
```

```{r alternating glms using 1 l.v.}
# KL divergence should be outside
# Fit alt_glm to B simulated datasets
dir.create("glm_models", showWarnings = TRUE)
dir.create("glm_models/fitting", showWarnings = TRUE)

source("alt_glm.R")

X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2])
Y = microbial[, 1:200]
set.seed(0)

glm_1 = alt_glm(sim_counts = as.matrix(Y), X = X, u = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)), N = 100)
  
save(glm_1, file = file.path("glm_models/fitting", "glm_1.RDATA"))
load("glm_models/fitting/glm_1.RDATA")
pred_mu_glm1 = glm_1$pred_counts

time_glm1 = glm_1$time
loglik_new_glm1 = glm_1$loglik_new

save(time_glm1, loglik_new_glm1, file = file.path("glm_models/fitting", "glm1_summary.RDATA"))

load(file.path("glm_models", "glm1_summary.RDATA"))
time_glm1
loglik_new_glm1
```

```{r RMSE}
which.min(rmses)
```


```{r Rotating, scaling u, lambda}
identify_ulambda <- function(u, lambda) {
  
  # dimensions
  D <- ncol(u)
  
  u_c <- scale(u, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)

  # 2. PCA rotation
  pca <- prcomp(u_c, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
  
  if (any(pca$sdev < sqrt(.Machine$double.eps))) {
    stop("u contains a latent dimension with approximately zero variance.")
  }
  
  # 3. PCA whitening: Cov(UTheta) = I
  Theta <- pca$rotation %*% 
    diag(1 / pca$sdev, nrow = D)
  
  UTheta <- u_c %*% Theta
  
  # Transform Lambda to preserve u_c lambda^T
  Lambda0 <- lambda %*% solve(t(Theta))
  
  # 4. QR identification of Lambda0^T
  qr_L <- qr(t(Lambda0))
  Q <- qr.Q(qr_L)
  R <- qr.R(qr_L)
  
  # 5. Force diagonal of R to be positive
  sgn <- sign(diag(R))
  sgn[sgn == 0] <- 1
  S <- diag(sgn, nrow = D)
  
  #Flips signs in Q and R together, two sign changes cancel after when computing QR
  Q <- Q %*% S 
  R <- S %*% R 
  
  # 6. Final identified U and Lambda
  U <- UTheta %*% Q
  Lambda <- t(R)
  
  return(list(
    U = U,
    Lambda = Lambda
  ))
}

load("gllvm_models/fitting/gllvm_2.RDATA")
load("glm_models/fitting/glm_2.RDATA")
load("jmle_models/fitting/jmle_2.RDATA")
load("glmnet_models/fitting/glmnet_2.RDATA")

ULambda_gllvm = identify_ulambda(gllvm_2$lvs, gllvm_2$params$theta)
U_gllvm = ULambda_gllvm$U
#colMeans(U_gllvm)
#cov(U_gllvm)
Lambda_gllvm = ULambda_gllvm$Lambda
var_ulambda_gllvm = Lambda_gllvm%*%var(U_gllvm)%*%t(Lambda_gllvm)

ULambda_glm = identify_ulambda(glm_2$u, glm_2$lambda)
U_glm = ULambda_glm$U
Lambda_glm = ULambda_glm$Lambda
var_ulambda_glm = Lambda_glm%*%var(U_glm)%*%t(Lambda_glm)

ULambda_jmle = identify_ulambda(jmle_2$u, jmle_2$lambda)
U_jmle = ULambda_jmle$U
Lambda_jmle = ULambda_jmle$Lambda
var_ulambda_jmle = Lambda_jmle%*%var(U_jmle)%*%t(Lambda_jmle)
```

```{r Biplot}
manual_biplot <- function(u, lambda, y, n_species = 10, site = Xenv$Xenv.Site,
                          main = "") {
  
  # select species with largest loading magnitude
  load_strength <- sqrt(rowSums(lambda^2))
  selected_sp <- order(load_strength, decreasing = TRUE)[1:n_species]
  
  # scale arrows to latent scores
  lambda_sel = lambda[selected_sp, , drop = FALSE]
  
  #make longest arrow 1.2 units long through taking max length of an arrow
  arrow_length = sqrt(rowSums(lambda_sel^2))
  arrow_scale = 2/max(arrow_length)
  
  #colour-code sites
  site = factor(site)
  site_cols = hcl.colors(nlevels(site), "Dynamic")
  point_cols = site_cols[as.numeric(site)]
  
  par(pty = "s")
  plot(
    u[, 1], u[, 2],
    xlab = "LV1",
    ylab = "LV2",
    pch = 16,
    col = point_cols,
    asp = 1,
    xlim = c(-3, 3),
    ylim = c(-4, 2),
    main = main
  )
  
  arrows(
    x0 = 0, y0 = 0,
    arrow_scale * lambda_sel[, 1],
    arrow_scale * lambda_sel[, 2],
    length = 0.08
  )
  
  text(
    arrow_scale * lambda[selected_sp, 1],
    arrow_scale * lambda[selected_sp, 2],
    labels = colnames(y)[selected_sp],
    pos = 4,
    cex = 0.7
  )
  
  legend("bottomright",
         legend = levels(site),
         col = site_cols,
         pch = 16,
         cex = 0.6)
}
```
